text: 倍轻松：控股股东、实际控制人马学军收到证监会《行政处罚决定书》，因操纵“倍轻松”案被没收违法所得1011.83万元、罚款3035.48万元，合计4047.31万元，其中马学军承担1184.19万元，并被采取5年证券市场禁入措施及5年证券市场禁止交易措施。公司称事项系其个人问题，与公司生产经营无关。
text_en: Breo: Controlling shareholder and actual controller Ma Xuejun received the CSRC's Administrative Penalty Decision. For manipulating the stock of "Breo," illegal gains of 10.1183 million yuan were confiscated and a fine of 30.3548 million yuan was imposed, totaling 40.4731 million yuan, of which Ma Xuejun bears 11.8419 million yuan. He was also subject to a five-year securities market ban and a five-year prohibition on securities market trading. The company said the matter is his personal issue and unrelated to the company's production and operations.
